BiblicalUsage: In Daniel we find çabbᵉkâʼ, the word for a lyre. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çabbᵉkâʼ is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
